sources.title: nvidia / nemotron-3.5-embed-1b
sources.snippet: The Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B-BF16 is suitable for users who want to build a multimodal question-and-answer application over a large corpus, leveraging the latest dense retrieval technology. The input of the model is a text or a document image, and the output is a fixed-size embedding vector. sources.snippet: Nemotron Pre- and Post-Training Datasets NVIDIA provides more than 12T tokens of multilingual reasoning, coding, and safety data, plus the post-training datasets that ship with Nemotron models, to help the community build their custom models. Released with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: a synthetic Indic pretraining corpus of about 2.83T tokens in 22 languages, co-created with IIT Madras.
